direct_cause: Server retains model across engine changes and UI neither reloads engine-specific discovery nor invalidates late list replies; provider grouping treats every unqualified model ID as its own namespace and then filters it away
class_root: Engine identity must own both selected model and asynchronous model discovery
affected_population: Browser users switching between native engines
Delayed model discovery or settings replies after engine/workspace replacement
entry_points: Browser settings and asynchronous model discovery
invariants: Changing engine clears prior-engine explicit model selection
Every displayed model list belongs to current engine and workspace
Stale discovery and settings settlements never replace current engine state
Only explicitly namespaced model IDs participate in provider grouping; unqualified IDs remain visible direct model facts

generality_proof: Server clears cross-engine selection for every settings caller; browser requests carry current engine and a monotonic read identity including workspace lifetime

Invalidate stale asynchronous selections and discovery
